items.title: Bitcoin's volatility has plunged, but extreme price swings are more frequent than in 2018
items.snippet: CoinDesk analysis finds 10 unusually large trading days in 2026, raising questions about how investors measure risk in an increasingly institutional crypto market.

items.title: Robinhood Chain slowdown spreads from fees to trading as transactions fall more than 40%
items.snippet: Daily activity has dropped from 10.8 million transactions to 6.2 million since mid-September even as Robinhood keeps paying network fees on customer swaps.

items.title: XRP Ledger patched decade-old bug that could create billions of dollars in XRP from nothing
items.snippet: Researchers demonstrated how a payment could create spendable XRP without the sender funding it, prompting an emergency software release.

items.title: Visa survey says nearly half of APAC consumers open to using stablecoins by 2031
items.snippet: Visa’s survey of 14,250 people found interest in stablecoin payments is growing, though only 6% of respondents correctly understood how they work.
